newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia names banks to place June Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Russia names banks to place June Eurobond.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry chose Russia's Alfa-Bank, Avtobank, AKB Mezhdunarodnaya Finansovaya Kompaniya (MFK) and Bank Rossiisky Kredit to help place the Russian Eurobond being issued this month, First Deputy Finance Minister Alexei Kudrin said on Monday.
Lead-managers on the issue, which is likely to run for 10 years and be $1 billion in volume, are JP Morgan and SBC Warburg.
Russia is now holding a road-show, to be over on Wednesday, for the issue.
Alfa-Bank, Bank Imperial, Bank MFK and Bank Rossiisky Kredit helped place Russia's second Eurobond in March.
